beats.event: Her wealthy father remarries a proud widow with two haughty daughters
Stepmother forces her into servitude, doing menial chores day and night
Sleeps by the ashes; nicknamed Cendrillon in mockery
Royal ball is announced; stepsisters taunt that maids are not invited
She helps her stepsisters dress for the ball and weeps when they leave
Fairy godmother appears, transforms pumpkin to coach, mice to horses
In glass slippers and a jeweled gown she enters the ball; prince entranced
She remembers the warning and leaves the palace before midnight
Attends a second ball the next evening; the prince cannot leave her side
Midnight strikes; fleeing, she loses one glass slipper on the palace steps
Prince vows to marry only the girl the slipper fits
Herald tries the slipper on every woman; stepsisters fail
Slipper fits Cinderella perfectly; she produces its mate from her pocket
She forgives the weeping stepsisters and marries the prince
As princess, she marries her stepsisters off to two wealthy noblemen
